Package data

Class SimulationQueue

java.lang.Object
data.SimulationQueue
public class SimulationQueue extends Object
A thread-safe communication channel between the Simulation Thread (Producer) and the JavaFX UI Thread (Consumer).

This class implements the Producer-Consumer design pattern using a BlockingQueue. It ensures that the heavy calculations performed by SUMO do not freeze the User Interface by buffering the results in a thread-safe manner.

Version:
1.0
Author:
pth

  • Constructor Details

    • SimulationQueue

      public SimulationQueue(int capacity)
      Constructs a new SimulationQueue with a fixed capacity.
      Parameters:
      capacity - The maximum number of simulation states (frames) the queue can hold before blocking the producer. This prevents memory overflow if the UI lags.

  • Method Details

    • putState

      public void putState(data.SimulationState frame) throws InterruptedException
      Inserts a simulation state into the queue, waiting if necessary for space to become available.

      Usage: This method is called by the Simulation Thread (Producer).

      Parameters:
      frame - The computed state of the simulation (snapshot).
      Throws:
      InterruptedException - if the thread is interrupted while waiting.

    • takeState

      public data.SimulationState takeState() throws InterruptedException
      Retrieves and removes the head of this queue, waiting if necessary until an element becomes available.

      Usage: General purpose blocking retrieval.

      Returns:
      The next SimulationState object.
      Throws:
      InterruptedException - if the thread is interrupted while waiting.

    • pollState

      public data.SimulationState pollState() throws InterruptedException
      Retrieves and removes the head of this queue, or returns null if this queue is empty.

      Usage: This method is called by the JavaFX AnimationTimer (Consumer). It is non-blocking to ensure the UI never freezes, even if the simulation loop is running slower than the frame rate.

      Returns:
      The next SimulationState object, or null if the queue is empty.
      Throws:
      InterruptedException - if the thread is interrupted.

    • offerState

      public void offerState(data.SimulationState frame) throws InterruptedException
      Inserts the specified element into this queue if it is possible to do so immediately without violating capacity restrictions.
      Parameters:
      frame - The state to add.
      Throws:
      InterruptedException - if the thread is interrupted.
